steps.instruction: Putar kunci kontak ke OFF dan cabut kuncinya. Tegakkan motor dengan standar tengah di tempat rata berventilasi.

steps.instruction: Pegang karet cop busi dan tarik lurus ke atas. Jangan tarik kabelnya agar tidak putus.

steps.expected_state: cop busi hitam terlepas menggantung di kabel, ujung busi logam terlihat terbuka

steps.instruction: Sikat ujung busi dengan sikat kawat kecil sampai bersih dan kering. Buang bensin atau oli yang membasahi elektroda.

steps.expected_state: elektroda ujung busi terlihat bersih terang tanpa kerak hitam tebal atau basah

steps.instruction: Masukkan busi dengan tangan dan putar ke kanan sampai mentok. Kencangkan sedikit dengan kunci, jangan terlalu kuat.

steps.expected_state: busi terpasang tegak dan kencang di kepala silinder, tidak miring atau longgar

steps.instruction: Dorong cop busi ke ujung busi sampai rapat dan tidak goyang. Pastikan tidak ada celah antara cop dan busi.

steps.voice_text: Pasang cop busi sampai rapat, pastikan tidak goyang.

steps.instruction: Turn ignition OFF, remove key and put bike on center stand on flat ground. Check head is cool with back of hand, do not continue if hot.
steps.why: Prevents accidental starting and burns while working near the cylinder head.
steps.expected_state: ignition key removed, bike upright on center stand, cylinder head cool to touch
warnings: Hot engine can burn skin

steps.voice_text: Ignition off, key out. Bike on center stand. Only work when the engine is cold.

steps.instruction: Wipe dust off plug cap and head with dry rag. Grip rubber cap, twist slightly and pull straight off.
steps.why: Keeps dirt out of the cylinder and protects the ignition lead from damage.
steps.expected_state: area wiped clean, spark plug cap pulled off and white ceramic plug tip visible
warnings: Do not yank the cable, it can break
steps.voice_text: Wipe dust away, then twist and pull the rubber cap gently.

steps.instruction: Fit 16mm plug socket over plug and turn counter-clockwise by hand. Lift plug out and place on rag.
steps.why: Removes the fouled plug so you can inspect and replace it without dropping debris inside.
steps.expected_state: spark plug removed and placed on rag, empty plug hole visible in cylinder head
warnings: Sharp edges on cooling fins can cut
steps.voice_text: Socket on, turn left to unscrew. Lift the plug out carefully.

steps.instruction: Screw new or cleaned dry plug in by hand clockwise until snug. Snug only 1/4 turn more with socket.
steps.why: Correct seating restores compression and spark gap for reliable firing.
steps.expected_state: clean or new spark plug threaded fully into cylinder head, metal base seated with no gap
warnings: Do not over-tighten, threads can strip
steps.voice_text: Screw the clean plug in by hand, then snug it just a quarter turn.

steps.instruction: Push spark plug cap firmly onto plug until it clicks. Tug lightly to confirm it stays on.
steps.why: Firm cap contact delivers full ignition voltage to the plug without misfire.

steps.instruction: Turn key OFF, remove key, and put bike on center stand on flat ground. Touch head lightly to confirm cool.
steps.why: This prevents high-voltage shock and burns while you handle the cap.
steps.expected_state: key removed, bike upright on center stand, engine area in view
warnings: Hot engine can burn - do not touch if hot
steps.voice_text: Let's make it safe. Key off, bike upright, engine cool.

steps.instruction: Grip the plug cap only and pull it straight off the plug. Wipe outside and inside of the cap with a dry rag.
steps.why: Dust and moisture inside the cap leak spark away from the plug.
steps.expected_state: spark plug cap pulled off, plug top exposed, cap wiped clean
warnings: Sharp engine fins can cut - move slowly
steps.voice_text: Pull the cap off gently, then wipe it clean and dry.

steps.instruction: Wipe the black ignition lead from top to cap and look for cracks. Twist the cap clockwise onto the lead until tight.
steps.why: A loose or dirty lead gives weak contact and no spark.
steps.expected_state: ignition lead clean and straight, cap screwed tight onto lead with no gap
steps.voice_text: Wipe the cable clean, then twist the cap on tight.

steps.instruction: Push the cap straight onto the spark plug hard until it clicks seated. Tug lightly to confirm it does not pop off.
steps.why: Full seating restores firm contact for a strong spark.
steps.expected_state: the plug cap is pushed fully onto the spark plug, no gap
warnings: Do not hold cap or lead while cranking - high-voltage shock risk
steps.voice_text: Push the cap on hard until it clicks with no gap.

steps.instruction: Turn key ON and press starter up to 5 seconds with hands away from cap. Stop if engine fires.
steps.why: This tests if better contact restored spark without touching high voltage.
steps.expected_state: plug cap still fully seated after cranking, engine fires or cranks
warnings: Keep hands and rag away from moving parts during crank
steps.voice_text: Hands clear now. Try the starter for a few seconds.

plan.done_check: Engine fires and keeps idling with the plug cap fully seated. If it still only cranks with no fire after 2 short tries, this fix did not work.
plan.when_to_call_pro: Call a mechanic if it still will not fire, the lead is cracked, or you see sparks jumping along the cable.
